answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybils. Each epoch offers limited slots at 25 POA each. An honest agent tends one orchard and passes review, refunded minus 1 POA. A forger needing 100 fakes funds 100 slots; failed review burns them: 100 x 25 = 2,500 POA against a 900 POA pool. A whisper of fake work triggers an audit; like water in karst sinkholes, each fake swallows its deposit. Honest agents pay once and keep the full reward.
